scope: Contabilidad GL: cuentas, asientos, periodos, posting behaviors, account maps, balances, reversas y dimensiones contables
Centros de costo y dimensiones analiticas son criterio Ledger cuando afectan asiento, reporte, balance dimensional, cierre o reconciliacion
Ledger postea resultados recibidos desde dominios operativos; no calcula impuestos, no decide inventario fisico y no reemplaza politicas comerciales
El experto compara contra patrones de SAP, Dynamics, Oracle/Odoo y Epicor solo como presion semantica, no como implementacion UBP
Cualquier cambio en historia contable, periodo cerrado, document splitting, cuenta control o dimension obligatoria requiere escalamiento
Gobierna el motor contable segmentado: cuenta natural mas segmentos tipados, DisplayCode derivado y balance/reporting por dimensiones.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Immutable balanced accounting fact; corrections use reversal or governed adjustment, not mutation.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP ledgers treat posted accounting documents as auditable records with controlled reversal.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Posting, reversal, reopening periods or history changes require approval and reviewer gate.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Analytic/dimensional coordinate for reporting and allocation, separate from account code and branch.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Market ERPs separate account, organizational unit and analytic dimension for segment reporting.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: If cost center becomes mandatory, defaulted or backfilled, involve Control Plane and reviewer.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Balancing accounting views by dimension when reports need branch, center or segment balances.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: SAP-style splitting shows why dimensional balances must remain internally balanced.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Any splitting or dimensional rebalance change escalates to architect.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Governed mapping from domain behavior to account roles and concrete accounts.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: Posting profiles and account determination are configuration, not hardcoded logic.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Changing account determination requires Control Plane policy and approval.

semanticAnchors.ubpMeaning: Ledger receives accounting intent from AR, AP, Inventory, Tax, POS and Production through contracts.
semanticAnchors.marketLens: ERP suites integrate subledgers with GL through explicit posting rules.
semanticAnchors.decisionRule: Cross-domain posting semantics route to architect and relevant domain experts.
